content.name: Ananya Sharma
content.title: Administrative Assistant
content.summary: Commerce graduate (B.Com, CGPA 8.1) with an internship and two years as an administrative assistant at a textile export firm. Handles vendor records, travel and Tally entries carefully, and reduced the time to close monthly petty cash from three days to one.

experience.title: Office Administration Intern
bullets: Managed member check-ins, meeting-room bookings and visitor passes for a centre with 120 members.
Updated the member database in Google Sheets and sent renewal reminders, helping keep renewals above 85% that quarter.
Compiled a simple supplier comparison for pantry and stationery items, saving about ₹6,000 a month.

experience.title: Administrative Assistant
bullets: Coordinate travel, hotel bookings and visa paperwork for the export team's buyer visits, around 25 trips a year.
Maintain vendor master data and record petty cash and courier expenses in Tally Prime for the accounts team.
Introduced a daily petty cash sheet with receipts scanned the same day, cutting month-end closing from three days to one.
Prepare minutes for weekly production meetings in English and Hindi and follow up on open actions with department heads.

education.school: Govt. Senior Secondary School, Malviya Nagar

achievements.title: College fest organising committee
achievements.detail: Handled registrations and budgets for 900 participants at the annual commerce fest.

achievements.title: NSS volunteer
achievements.detail: Ran a 3-week digital literacy camp for 40 women in a nearby village.
